title: Status Share Record Test for the Seat Waiver: Student Transportation Services and School Nutrition Meal Status
content:
For the Student Transportation Services seat waiver on a waiting-list courtesy permit fee, the status share is read from the meal status on file in the student's School Nutrition Services Meal Account on the day the seat waiver is figured, by this record test:

| Status on file | Day it took effect | Status share |
|---|---|---|
| any Free Meal Status tier | on or before the fee's posting date | the free-meal waiver share of the fee table, 100 percent |
| Paid Meal Status | any day | zero |
| any tier | after the fee's posting date | zero |
| the student has no meal account | none | zero |
| any Reduced-Price Meal Status tier | on or before the fee's posting date | the reduced-price waiver share of the fee table, 50 percent |

## Both sides of the posting date (hypothetical seat fee posted on a Tuesday)

| Status on file | Took effect | Status share |
|---|---|---|
| Free Meal Status (Direct Certification) | that Tuesday | 100 percent |
| Free Meal Status (Direct Certification) | the Wednesday after | zero |
| Reduced-Price Meal Status | the Monday before | 50 percent |
